A '''stormtrooper''' was active on the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]]<ref name="Kenobi III" /> in [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] is set ten [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' must be set in [[9 BBY]].</ref> As part of the reinvigorated [[Hunt for Obi-Wan Kenobi|hunt]] for the [[Jedi]] fugitive [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], he was paired with [[Unidentified stormtrooper 1 (Mapuzo safehouse)|another trooper]] to check buildings, which happened to include the safehouse used by [[Tala Durith]]. The trooper persuaded his partner out of getting confrontational with a [[loader droid]], [[NED-B]], and to continue with their sweep.<ref name="Kenobi III" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[stormtrooper]] first appeared in "[[Part III]]" the third episode of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']].<ref name="Kenobi III" />
